title: TC LMS SG - Tertiary Courses
shortDescription: Your Tertiary Courses Singapore classes, attendance, materials & certificates.
fullDescription:
TC LMS SG is the learner app for Tertiary Courses Singapore (www.tertiarycourses.com.sg). Sign in with the email you registered with and everything about your classes is in one place.

SIGN IN YOUR WAY
• Get a one-time code by email, or use your website password.

MY CLASSES
• See your current, upcoming and past classes with dates, times, venue or online class link, and trainer.
• Join live online classes in one tap.

DIGITAL ATTENDANCE
• Check in to the current session from your phone when you arrive.
• See which sessions you have attended.

CLASS MATERIALS
• Open your learner slides, learner guide, lesson plan and labs for each class.

COURSE FEEDBACK
• Complete the in-house course feedback survey right in the app.

CALENDAR
• A month view of your class days, and "Add My Classes to Calendar" for your phone's calendar.

CERTIFICATES
• View and share your certificates once they are issued.

BILLING
• See your course registrations, payment status and invoice numbers.

BROWSE COURSES
• Explore our non-WSQ short courses, see durations and fees, and enquire on WhatsApp.

Your learner account is created when you register for a course on www.tertiarycourses.com.sg. You can delete your account at any time from Account → Delete Account.
releaseNotes:
